reconstruction_commands.source_hash_method: SHA-256 over sorted path NUL file_sha256 LF for tracked regular files under server, apps, packages, scripts, Makefile, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml; compare all 7960 per-file hashes to retained pre-source-manifest.json.
reconstruction_commands.framework_hash_method: Sort rk1_*_test.go by name; append basename NUL byte_length NUL then file bytes; SHA-256 over concatenation.
reconstruction_commands.named_count_method: Parse each raw Go JSONL event; count run/pass/fail/skip only when Test is nonempty; require one unique run/pass pair per name. Reconstruct package terminal separately.
reconstruction_commands.artifact_method: SHA-256 over exact existing bytes; parse all 44 public/trace pairs, all 64 private ledgers and launch captures. Compare proof/outcome/seal/physical-termination payloads to private ledger, actual stdin digest/envelope to handoff bind/snapshot, distinct permit pairs to physical launch count, raw stdout counters/models and registered trial state/numbering.
